notes.title: Multiplayer Connection Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where some users were unable to connect to multiplayer sessions.

- This was likely caused by network configuration conflicts, including proxy or firewall-related issues.

- The connection flow has been updated to improve compatibility across a wider range of network environments.

Let us know if you still experience any connectivity issues—your feedback helps us make the game better!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes Update (v1.0.1)
notes.content: We've squashed a few pesky bugs in Perplex to improve your gameplay experience. While there are no major changes in this update, these behind-the-scenes tweaks help keep things running smoothly. Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Perplex is now live!
notes.content:
🎉 Perplex is Here! Dive into the Neon Puzzle Adventure! 🎉

After countless hours of late-night coding sessions, endless coffee cups, and a sprinkle of sweat and tears, we’re thrilled to announce that Perplex is finally LIVE on Steam! 🚀

Get ready to challenge your mind and reflexes in a vibrant, retro-inspired world filled with over 275 single-player levels, 40 co-op challenges, and 100 PvP arenas! We’ve poured our hearts into creating a game that blends nostalgia with fresh, mind-bending puzzles. 💡✨

Whether you’re teaming up with friends or competing for bragging rights, Perplex offers endless fun and excitement. So jump into the neon chaos, your next adventure awaits!

Thank you for your support on this incredible journey! Let’s get Perplexed!

notes.title: Perplex Demo is Now Live on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Exciting news, puzzle lovers! The demo for Perplex is officially available as part of Steam Next Fest! 🎉

Get ready to challenge your mind with our unique 2D puzzle adventure, featuring intricate puzzles, co-op and PvP modes, and a beautifully designed world that will keep you hooked.

🔹 Play the demo now and get a sneak peek at the full experience!
🔹 Team up with a friend or compete in thrilling PvP battles.
🔹 Share your thoughts and feedback with us—we’d love to hear from you!

Don't miss out! Download the demo today and let the puzzling begin. 🧩

notes.title: Can You Beat My Puzzle Platformer? 🔥 Live Playthrough!
notes.content:
🌟 Welcome to My Steam Fest Live Stream! 🚀

Get ready to dive into a neon-infused puzzle platformer that will challenge your mind and reflexes! In this game, you'll navigate through glowing mazes, portal jumps, and precision dashes to reach the goal. Can you solve these mind-bending puzzles?

🎮 What to Expect in This Stream:
✅ Live gameplay and level showcases
✅ Developer insights & behind-the-scenes details
✅ Play the free demo now and share your thoughts!
